panels.title: Total wall-time · A vs B (avg ms / ingest)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'A: ' || '$version_a' AS label, AVG(total_ms) AS ms FROM (SELECT workflow_run_id, SUM(duration_ms) AS total_ms FROM ingest_metrics WHERE version_tag = '$version_a' GROUP BY workflow_run_id) s
UNION ALL
SELECT 'B: ' || '$version_b', AVG(total_ms) FROM (SELECT workflow_run_id, SUM(duration_ms) AS total_ms FROM ingest_metrics WHERE version_tag = '$version_b' GROUP BY workflow_run_id) s

SELECT activity_name,
       AVG(CASE WHEN version_tag = '$version_a' THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_a,
       AVG(CASE WHEN version_tag = '$version_b' THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_b
  FROM ingest_metrics
 WHERE version_tag IN ('$version_a', '$version_b')
 GROUP BY activity_name
 ORDER BY activity_name

WITH a AS (SELECT activity_name, AVG(duration_ms) AS avg_ms, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p95_ms FROM ingest_metrics WHERE version_tag = '$version_a' GROUP BY activity_name),
     b AS (SELECT activity_name, AVG(duration_ms) AS avg_ms, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p95_ms FROM ingest_metrics WHERE version_tag = '$version_b' GROUP BY activity_name)
SELECT COALESCE(a.activity_name, b.activity_name) AS activity,
       ROUND(a.avg_ms::numeric, 0) AS avg_ms_A,
       ROUND(b.avg_ms::numeric, 0) AS avg_ms_B,
       ROUND((b.avg_ms - a.avg_ms)::numeric, 0) AS delta_ms,
       CASE WHEN a.avg_ms > 0 THEN ROUND(((b.avg_ms - a.avg_ms) / a.avg_ms * 100)::numeric, 1) END AS delta_pct,
       ROUND(a.p95_ms::numeric, 0) AS p95_A,
       ROUND(b.p95_ms::numeric, 0) AS p95_B
  FROM a FULL OUTER JOIN b USING (activity_name)
 ORDER BY activity
